items.title: Varnar efter C-toppens M-öppning: ”Skulle slita itu partiet”
items.summary: C-toppen Emma Ytterells öppning för en Kristersson-regering väcker starka reaktioner – både internt i Centerpartiet och i de rödgröna partierna. – Det skulle slita itu partiet. Jag tror att vi skulle gå samma öde till mötes som L, säger Christian Widlund, C, kommunalråd i Norrköping.

items.title: Susanne Ljung: Vilket modehus blir först med att sno Anne Carsons stil?
items.summary: Äldre välklädda kulturkvinnor ger modevärlden kulturell kredd. Inte undra på att det florerar rykten kända märken försöker sätta klorna i Nobelpristagaren Anne Carson, skriver DN:s Susanne Ljung.

items.title: Sweden and the UN – 80 years of commitment to peace, development and human rights
items.summary: On 19 November, Sweden marked 80 years since becoming a member of the UN. Sweden’s commitment to the UN is broad and long-term. Almost 100 000 Swedes have served at the UN throughout the years. Sweden is also one of the largest donors to the UN system.

items.title: Sweden takes part in NATO’s STARLIFT space initiative
items.summary: Minister for Defence Pål Jonson has signed an agreement with NATO Allies to develop a network of space centres to enable the launch of satellites at short notice. Sweden’s Esrange Space Center is part of this network.

items.title: Sweden’s Minister for Climate and the Environment delivered a speech in support of Ukraine at COP31
items.summary: Minister for Climate and the Environment Romina Pourmokhtari delivered a speech in support of Ukraine at an event held on 18 November during the UN Climate Change Conference COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye. items.title: Sweden and India launch new phase in cooperation on industry’s climate transition
items.summary: Today, 17 November, Sweden and India launched the third phase of the Leadership Group for Industry Transition (LeadIT) climate cooperation at the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31). The LeadIT 3.0 platform will accelerate the transition in the area of heavy industry by mobilising technology, capital and knowledge support.

items.title: Sweden appoints new Ambassador and Head of Permanent Representation to NATO
items.summary: The Government has appointed Karin Höglund as Ambassador and Head of the Permanent Representation of Sweden to the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) in Brussels. Ms Höglund will take up her new post on 1 December 2026.

items.title: Sweden’s main priorities at COP31
items.summary: The United Nations Climate Change Conference, COP31, is now under way in Antalya, Türkiye and will continue until 20 November. Research indicates an urgent need for transition in our societies. At the same time, climate transition presents considerable opportunities for innovation, competitiveness and growth. Sweden’s foremost priority is to accelerate the implementation of countries’ nationally determined contributions’, NDCs.
